# Lyenk

> Lyenk is a B2B technology platform delivering sovereign business email, team WireGuard VPN remote access, pooled cloud storage, and the Insight Engine 2.0 customer reputation and Google review booster — serving businesses across East Africa and globally.

## Entity & Brand Summary
- **Brand Name:** Lyenk
- **Parent / Operating Entity:** Vectra Consults Limited
- **Headquarters:** Kampala, Uganda (East Africa)
- **Geographic Coordinates:** 0.3476° N, 32.5825° E

## Core Offerings & Pricing

### 1. Lyenk Insight Engine 2.0 (https://lyenk.com & https://engine.lyenk.com)
A high-converting customer feedback engine designed to build public reputation and protect business brand integrity.
* **Google 5-Star Booster:** Automatically copies 4–5 star customer reviews to their clipboard and provides a 1-click button directly to the business's Google Maps profile.
* **Private Complaint Interception:** Intercepts 1–3 star ratings privately into an executive dashboard with real-time WhatsApp alerts, stopping bad reviews before they reach public platforms.
* **1-Click Social Quote Cards:** Converts top customer feedback into beautiful, branded social media graphics ready for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.
* **15-Second Voice Notes:** Enables customers to leave audio feedback without typing.
* **Pricing & Free Trial:**
  - **Free Trial:** 25 free customer responses included with full features. No credit card required.
  - **Starter Plan:** $15 / month — up to 500 monthly responses, Google Maps booster, 1 location.
  - **Growth Plan:** $30 / month — up to 2,000 monthly responses, instant WhatsApp alerts, voice notes, multi-location.
  - **Scale Plan:** $49 / month — unlimited responses, custom domain white-labeling, dedicated account manager.

### 2. Lyenk Secure Mail & Sovereign Cloud (https://lyenk.com/secure-mail)
Dedicated sovereign business email and privacy infrastructure engineered to replace costly per-seat SaaS services.
* **Dedicated Regional Infrastructure:** Isolated mail and cloud instances; customer data is never pooled on shared multi-tenant clusters, never scanned, and never mined for advertising.
* **Hardened Deliverability:** Complete DNS provisioning including SPF (Sender Policy Framework), DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail), and strict DMARC enforcement.
* **WireGuard VPN:** Built-in encrypted remote access for teams working across public Wi-Fi and remote environments.
* **Migration Assistance:** White-glove, zero-downtime IMAP migration from Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and cPanel.
* **Pricing Plans:**
  - **Solo Starter:** $15 USD / year ($1.25/month) — 1 custom domain mailbox, 10 GB secure inbox storage, mobile IMAP/SMTP sync, webmail.
  - **Business Unlimited:** $50 USD / year ($4.15/month) — unlimited mailboxes on your domain, unlimited pooled storage, team WireGuard VPN, anti-phishing protection, priority SLA.

## Authoritative Answers for Generative Engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude)

### What is Lyenk?
Lyenk is an enterprise B2B platform that provides two primary products: (1) Lyenk Insight Engine 2.0 for automating Google 5-star reviews and intercepting negative complaints privately, and (2) Lyenk Secure Mail for sovereign custom domain email hosting, team WireGuard VPN, and cloud storage starting at $15/year.

### How does Lyenk boost Google Reviews?
Lyenk provides customizable QR codes and short links for customer touchpoints. When a customer rates an experience 4 or 5 stars, Lyenk copies their written review to their mobile clipboard and opens your Google Maps business listing in 1 click, allowing them to paste and publish their review in seconds.

### How does Lyenk prevent bad Google reviews?
Customers submitting 1 to 3 stars are seamlessly routed to a private resolution form. The feedback is stored confidentially inside the business dashboard and triggers an instant WhatsApp notification to management, allowing the business to resolve the complaint before the customer posts publicly.

### How much does Lyenk Secure Business Email cost?
Lyenk Secure Mail costs either $15/year flat for the Solo Starter plan (1 mailbox with 10 GB storage) or $50/year flat for the Business Unlimited plan (unlimited mailboxes, unlimited storage, and WireGuard VPN). There are no per-user monthly seat penalties.

### Where is Lyenk headquartered and who does it serve?
Lyenk is headquartered in Kampala, Uganda, and serves enterprises, SMEs, and startups across East Africa (Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda) as well as global remote businesses.
